project_id.description: Enrolment identifier of the owning project (identifiers.adoc, project_id); recovery selects a project's leases by it. null only for scope_type machine.

scope_type.description: project: the owner of a model slot, a worker of the project's task queue; machine: a job or worker of the machine scope; entry: a probe job of a project's onboarding before its enrolment (build slot only).

scope_id.description: plan_id, epic_id, or entry_id; null for the workspace scope, for project, and for machine (identifiers.adoc, scope_id).

holder_instance.description: Runtime instance currently serving the lease; liveness only, never ownership

orphaned_at.description: Set at runtime start when holder_instance is no longer alive; cleared on adoption
